name: Felgorged reduces the Energy cost of Cripple and Consume Magic (#1312)
contract: Felgorged reduces the Energy cost of Cripple (704371) and Consume Magic (800353) by 10, via a native SPELLMOD_COST (op14) flat SpellMod matching both spells' family20 classMask3 bits 0 and 13. The DBC stores EffectBasePoints -11 with DieSides 1, so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue resolves it to -10 (basePoints+1), one point above the tooltip's 11.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Felgorged reduces Cripple cost by 10 (EffectBasePoints -11 + 1, DieSides 1)
Base Consume Magic cost is unaffected
Felgorged reduces Consume Magic cost by 10 (EffectBasePoints -11 + 1, DieSides 1)
